items.heading: Carciofi alla Giudia
details: Key ingredients: artichokes, olive oil, lemon, salt
Trim whole artichokes down to their tender hearts and leaves.
Fry them slowly in olive oil until softened through.
Press the leaves open and fry again at higher heat until crisp.
Season with salt and a squeeze of lemon before serving.

items.heading: Saltimbocca alla Romana
details: Key ingredients: veal, prosciutto, sage, white wine, butter
Top thin veal cutlets with a sage leaf and a slice of prosciutto.
Secure with a toothpick and dust lightly with flour.
Pan-fry quickly in butter until the veal is just cooked.
Deglaze with white wine and spoon the sauce over before serving.
